column1: # puzzbobb's R2025_Models.zip (#356): 23 Revit 2025 projects each made to isolate a feature
# (roofs, slope arrows, rooms, doors and windows, stairs, wall joins), with Revit's own IFC4
# Reference View export of all but 07_1Slope_ArrowDefined_2Cut50mmFascia. Their author made
# them and released the .rvt and .ifc files under Apache-2.0 on #356 (2026-10-05). Fetched for
# a Measure run (`-f r2025=true`) by tools/ci/fetch-r2025-models.sh and never committed. The
# hash is the one the author posted; hash and size measured 2026-10-18.
# On #885 (2026-10-27) the author added, under Apache-2.0, R2025_TU_Roof.zip (20_T_U_Roof, a
# project with T and U hip roofs, and its IFC4 Reference View export) and R2025_Models_wRVTSets.zip
# (exports of the models with Revit's property sets on, no .rvt); of the latter only
# 07_1Slope_ArrowDefined_2Cut50mmFascia's is read, the first export of that model, renamed to sit
# beside its .rvt. The others are another export setup and are not read. Hashes and sizes measured
